run_sam2_video_object_tracking: run SAM2-Video inference on a video using point or mask prompts to track objects across frames
create_sam2_video_inference_session: create a Sam2VideoInferenceSession to manage video inference state, cached features, and per-object tracking data
build_sam2_video_mask_decoder: build the Sam2VideoMaskDecoder that predicts segmentation masks from image embeddings and sparse prompt embeddings
test_sam2_video_propagate_in_video: test propagating object tracking through all video frames via Sam2VideoModel.propagate_in_video_iterator
review_sam2_video_memory_attention: review the Sam2VideoMemoryAttention module that fuses current vision features with memory from previous frames using RoPE attention
